chunks: Or have they taken gods from the earth who can raise the dead?
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about gods who can raise the dead?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Anbiya, this verse employs a rhetorical question to dismantle the polytheists' claim that their idols possess independent creative power, specifically the ability to resurrect the dead. Shia exegesis highlights that 'yunsirun' (they raise/resurrect) refers to the power of bringing forth from the grave, a unique attribute of Allah, thereby proving the impotence of created idols. This serves as a logical proof (dalil) against shirk by contrasting the passive nature of idols with the active, sovereign power of the Creator.
